correctness.rationale: The two half-cones are interchanged by swapping x,y and reversing z, and both are invariant under independent horizontal sign changes; the centroid is therefore the origin. Homogeneity gives one reciprocal support-denominator per ray; if U3<0 the order of the two terms is exchanged, leaving the asserted sum unchanged. The two hemispheres and four sign choices give the projected density 2/(pi sqrt(1−x²−y²)). Extremizers of each reciprocal term yield exactly four diagonal equatorial minima and six coordinate-axis maxima. In an azimuth/height chart about a minimum the first-order displacements of the two absolute coordinates from 1/sqrt(2) are (±phi−z²/2)/sqrt(2); since f'=0 and f''=sqrt(2), the cross term cancels and the normalized chord excess is (phi²+z⁴/4)/sqrt(2)+o(phi²+z⁴). Area is uniform in azimuth and height, and the rescaled set has area 2^(7/8) B(1/4,3/2). Around a vertical maximum the length deficit is |x|+|y| to first order; around a horizontal maximum it is the transverse radius plus the absolute transverse horizontal coordinate. The associated unit sublevel areas are 2 and 4/3, respectively (the latter from the half-angle substitution in the polar area integral). Summing over poles yields 7/(3 pi) and class weights 3/7 and 4/7. For both endpoints compactness first confines the event to the extremal charts; coercivity of the leading forms bounds the scaled supports. Their level-one boundaries have planar measure zero, so the rescaled densities converge in L1 by dominated convergence, including after normalization. This establishes the conditional total-variation assertions and the powers 3/4 and 2 with the exact constants.
residual_risks: The deterministic diagnostics and reported finite Sobol ratios are corroborative only; neither is used for the tails or the TV proof.

value.rationale: The sphericon is a standard constructed solid and central chords are a natural directional invariant. Its quartic degeneracy in one tangent coordinate and two distinct upper-chart geometries are not conveyed by construction or volume data. The sharp coefficients and conditional limits explain which directions dominate rare extremes and how the directional concentrations differ, rather than merely providing a sampling recipe or a numerical estimate.
residual_risks: This is a shape-specific law, not a statement about arbitrary twisted cones, affine line chords, or uniform finite-threshold error bounds.
